contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP[CONSTAN]TINVS MAX AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE LEATAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), probably issue of 318-20, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP[CONSTAN]TINVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding inscribed shield over altar. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE LEATAE PRINC PERP].
